unit_label: NIST SP 800-162, Guide to Attribute Based Access Control
claims_supported: The basic ABAC mechanism contains a PDP and PEP; PAP manages policies and PIP supplies attributes.
PDP computes decisions and deconflicts DPs according to MPs; PEP enforces decisions.
PDP/PEP may be distributed or centralized and may be separated.
Policy administration covers NLP/DP/MP, repositories, authority and traceability.
Implementation considerations include interfaces, mutual authentication, caching and audit limits.
